title: ever LEORA|A-Line Pleated Chiffon Tie-Waist Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This sophisticated bridesmaid dress features flowing pleated layers of chiffon and a flattering tie-waist. Flutter sleeves, a plunging v-neckline, and an A-line silhouette exude a timeless elegance worthy of every picture.

Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.

Length: Floor-Length.

Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.

Closure: No zipper.

Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon.

Stretch: No stretch.
